description: Executable Candidate recipe of NVIDIA's DGX Spark playbook (vllm) for DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B IT BF16: vllm/vllm-openai:gemma (DiffusionGemma custom container named by the playbook), pinned by arm64 digest, serving the exact model revision through `vllm serve` with the playbook's flags (vLLM defaults where the playbook passes none). Resource envelopes budget the explicit GPU memory utilization plus unified-memory overhead, not measurements; physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B IT BF16 vLLM single Spark (NVIDIA playbook)
